title: Pure projection upcaster engine
description: Objective: a dependency-free, side-effect-free engine that upcasts stored events to their current domain schema version and folds them into projection state. SPIDR step 2 of 5, split from task-55d5a898264b4880a99bf2c5b3be120b. Deliverable: pure functions over in-memory values — no SQLite, no transactions, no I/O — so the fold is exhaustively testable without a database. Upcasters dispatch on the StoredEvent domain schema version added in step 1; an unknown or future version fails closed with a stable reason code and never silently passes the event through unmodified. NOT in scope: persistence, the relay/inbox transaction, subscriptions, CURSOR_GAP, or any SQLite access. Hard dependencies: Versioned event schema and projection commit seam (step 1) — needs the StoredEvent schema-version field to dispatch on. Owned paths: packages/store/src/projections/** and its focused tests. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test.
definitionOfDone: Upcasting and projection folding are pure functions over in-memory values with no SQLite, transaction, clock, or filesystem access, demonstrated by tests that construct no database.
An unknown or future domain schema version fails closed with a stable reason code; no event is silently passed through unmodified or dropped.
Folding the same event sequence twice yields identical frozen state, and out-of-order or duplicate input is rejected rather than absorbed.
The focused store typecheck and test command exits 0 and only explicitly owned paths are staged and committed.
taskRails: Purity is the deliverable. Any SQLite handle, transaction, clock read, or filesystem call in this subtree defeats the reason this step was split out.
Fail closed with stable reason codes on unknown versions; missing or unverifiable input stays UNKNOWN and never gains authority.
Use TDD. Keep each production source focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400. Commit by explicit pathspec only.
reopenReason: Governor: dependency verified landed. This task dispatches upcasters on the StoredEvent domain schema version, and that field is now COMMITTED at HEAD — git grep confirms domainSchemaVersion in packages/store/src/store-contracts.ts, event-ledger-append.ts, and store-input-commit.ts, with store-domain-schema-version.test.ts alongside. Its parent task (StoredEvent domain schema version and projection commit seam) is WORKING 2/6, but the field it owed this task has already landed, so there is real committed code to dispatch on. Note its stated dependency names the superseded parent shell task-50874e67 rather than the real Task B — resolved manually, do not be misled by that string. Owns packages/store/src/projections/** which is greenfield. Purity is the deliverable: no SQLite handle, transaction, clock read, or filesystem call in that subtree.

comments.author: architect-c4babdf9
comments.content: SPIDR sizing decision: one honest upcast+fold task needs two production responsibilities plus two bridges and hostile/determinism coverage (~500+ LOC), exceeding the <=400 task rail even if every file stays <=250. Created producer child task-14ba8b74f05f458d94591e02ce851e29 for the pure stored-event upcaster (3 files, <=386 LOC). After it lands, this parent becomes the pure fold/order consumer and should own exactly projection-fold.ts/.js/.test.ts (<=155/1/235): explicit checkpoint + recursive plain-data state, preflight strict globalPosition/unique eventId/per-aggregate nondecreasing sequence, call the child upcaster, reject duplicate/out-of-order before the offending reducer, return no partial state on reducer/upcast failure, and prove same-input deep-frozen determinism with fixed seeds. Package-root export, SQLite/quarantine/persistence, relay, and CURSOR_GAP stay out of scope; the later crash/rebuild task remains the epic hardening gate.

comments.author: architect-c4babdf9
comments.content: Correction to comment-70c6d93f50674af982bfeba0cc46b668: per-aggregate sequence must be strictly increasing within the supplied batch (equal is duplicate, lower is out-of-order), not merely nondecreasing. Do not require contiguity or sequence 1 because incremental pages/checkpoints may start midstream.

blockedReason: SPIDR interface split required: combining exact schema-route validation/upcasting with ordered frozen-state folding and mutation-resistant tests would exceed the <=400 net-LOC task rail. The producer interface is now isolated in child task-14ba8b74f05f458d94591e02ce851e29; planning the fold before its exact landed API would force speculative function/type names.
